notes:
**Status: approved by Christian on 2026-10-26.** CHR-925 / CHR-908. Opened from "What's New" in the settings menu.

**Dialog.** Modal over `chrome-scrim`, 640x640 fixed, radius.md 10, `chrome-shadow-float`; three zones: header (padding 24 24 12, title "What's New" 16px semibold + `close` icon button sm), scrolling body, footer (padding 12 24, hairline above). Only the body scrolls (`overflow-y:auto`, native scrollbar); header and footer stay put. Esc / scrim click / Close dismiss it.

**Body.** One section per release, newest first, 24px padding, 16px gap, hairline + 16px padding between releases. Heading line: version 15px semibold followed by the date 12px tertiary (rendered as "2.1.1 · 2026-10-21" in the data, drawn as two spans). Under it the Keep-a-Changelog body of that version, rendered as Markdown: optional intro paragraph (13px secondary), `###` subheadings (Added / Changed / Fixed ...) as 10.5px uppercase medium tertiary labels with 0.04em tracking, bullet lists (18px indent, 13px, line-height 1.5, 8px between items), `**bold**` = semibold, inline `code` = 12px mono on `chrome-field`, radius 4, padding 1px 5px. Links, if any, use `chrome-accent`.

**Sample content.** The two releases shown are the installed 2.1.1 and 2.1.0 (taken from `artisign/CHANGELOG.md`, lightly shortened). The menu shows 2.1.1, so showing a 2.2.0 section would contradict it; after an update to 2.2.0 the same dialog starts with `2.2.0 · <date>`.

**Footer.** Left: "Showing 2 releases · full history in CHANGELOG.md" (11.5px tertiary). Right: primary button "Close" (the single primary).
